text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟和亚郎说：

text_en: When a person has on the skin of his body a swelling or an eruption or a spot, and it turns into a leprous disease on the skin of his body, he shall be brought to Aaron the priest or to one of his sons the priests.
text_cn: “若人在肉皮上生了肿瘤或疮疖（jiē）或斑痕，他肉皮上有了这种癞病的症象，就应把他带到亚郎司祭，或他作司祭的一个儿子前。

text_en: The priest shall examine the disease on the skin of his body, and if the hair in the diseased area has turned white and the disease appears to be deeper than the skin of his body, it is a leprous disease; after the priest has examined him he shall pronounce him ceremonially unclean.
text_cn: 司祭应查看肉皮上的症象；若患处的毛变白，若患处似乎已深过肉皮，这便是癞病的症候。司祭一看出，就应声明他是不洁的。

text_en: But if the spot is white in the skin of his body, and appears no deeper than the skin, and the hair in it has not turned white, the priest shall confine the diseased person for seven days.
text_cn: 但若他肉皮上的斑痕发白，而不见得深过肉皮，毛又没有变白，司祭应将患者隔离七天。

text_en: The priest shall examine him on the seventh day, and if he sees that the disease is checked and the disease has not spread in the skin, then the priest shall confine him seven days more.
text_cn: 到第七天，司祭再查看他，如见患处颜色未变，皮上的患处没有蔓延，司祭应将他再隔离七天。

text_en: The priest shall examine him again on the seventh day, and if the disease has abated and the disease has not spread in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him clean; it is only an eruption; and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.
text_cn: 到第七天，司祭再查看他，如见患处颜色已淡，皮上的患处也没有蔓延，司祭应声明他是洁净的，这不过是一种疮疖；他洗过衣服，就洁净了。

text_en: But if the eruption spreads in the skin after he has shown himself to the priest for his cleansing, he shall appear again before the priest.
text_cn: 但在司祭查看，声明他洁净以后，如疮疖（jiē）在皮肤上又蔓延开，应再去叫司祭查看。

text_en: The priest shall make an examination, and if the eruption has spread in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him unclean; it is a leprous disease.
text_cn: 司祭应查看他，若见他皮肤上的疮疖（jiē）蔓延开了，应声明他是不洁的，已成为癞病。

text_en: When a person contracts a leprous disease, he shall be brought to the priest.
text_cn: 若人身上有了癞病的症象，应带他去见司祭；

text_en: The priest shall make an examination, and if there is a white swelling in the skin that has turned the hair white, and there is quick raw flesh in the swelling,
text_cn: 司祭应查看他，若见皮肤上白肿，毛已变白，肿处出现赘（zhuì）疣（yóu），

text_en: it is a chronic leprous disease in the skin of his body. The priest shall pronounce him unclean; he shall not confine him, for he is unclean.
text_cn: 这是他肉皮上的慢性癞病；司祭应声明他是不洁的，不必将他隔离，因为他已是不洁的。

text_en: But if the disease breaks out in the skin, so that it covers all the skin of the diseased person from head to foot, so far as the priest can see,
text_cn: 但若癞疮在皮上蔓延，凡司祭能看见的地方，从头到脚，癞疮遮盖了患者的全身皮肤，

text_en: then the priest shall make an examination, and if the disease has covered all his body, he shall pronounce him clean of the disease; since it has all turned white, he is clean.
text_cn: 司祭查看他，若见癞疮遮盖了他全身，就应声明患者是洁净的；因为全身变白，便是洁净的。

text_en: But if raw flesh ever appears on him, he shall be unclean;
text_cn: 但他身上一出现赘（zhuì）疣（yóu），就成了不洁净的；

text_en: the priest shall examine the raw flesh and pronounce him unclean. Raw flesh is unclean, for it is a leprous disease.
text_cn: 司祭一见这赘疣，就应声明他是不洁的；因为这赘疣是不洁的，分明是癞病。

text_en: But if the raw flesh again turns white, he shall come to the priest;
text_cn: 但若赘疣再变白，他应再去见司祭；

text_en: the priest shall examine him, and if the disease has turned white, the priest shall pronounce the diseased person clean. He is clean.
text_cn: 司祭查看他，若见患处变白，司祭应声明患者是洁净的；他便是洁净的。

text_en: When there is on the skin of one’s body a boil that has healed,
text_cn: 若人肉皮上生了疮，已医好了；

text_en: and in the place of the boil there appears a white swelling or a reddish-white spot, it shall be shown to the priest.
text_cn: 但在疮处又起了白肿，或白中带红的斑痕，就应去叫司祭查看。

text_en: The priest shall make an examination, and if it appears deeper than the skin and its hair has turned white, the priest shall pronounce him unclean; this is a leprous disease, broken out in the boil.
text_cn: 司祭查看他，若见患处似乎已深过皮肤，并且毛已变白，就应声明他是不洁的：这是由疮转成癞病的症象。

text_en: But if the priest examines it and the hair on it is not white, nor is it deeper than the skin but has abated, the priest shall confine him seven days.
text_cn: 但若司祭查看，见上面没有白毛，也未深过皮肤，颜色已淡，司祭就应将他隔离七天。

text_en: If it spreads in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him unclean; it is diseased.
text_cn: 若病在皮肤上蔓延开了，司祭就应声明他是不洁的：这是癞病的症象。

text_en: But if the spot remains in one place and does not spread, it is the scar of the boil; the priest shall pronounce him clean.
text_cn: 但是，如果斑痕留在原处，没有蔓延，这是疮痕；司祭应声明他是洁净的。

text_en: Or, when the body has a burn on the skin and the raw flesh of the burn becomes a spot, reddish-white or white,
text_cn: 若人肉皮上受了火伤，伤处的赘疣生了白里带红，或纯白的斑痕，

text_en: the priest shall examine it. If the hair in the spot has turned white and it appears deeper than the skin, it is a leprous disease; it has broken out in the burn, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean. This is a leprous disease.
text_cn: 司祭就应查看他：若见斑痕上的毛已变白，似乎深过皮肤，这是由火伤转成的癞病，司祭应声明他为不洁：这是癞病的症候。

text_en: But if the priest examines it and the hair in the spot is not white, and it is no deeper than the skin but has abated, the priest shall confine him seven days.
text_cn: 但若司祭查看，见斑痕上没有白毛，并未深过皮肤，而且颜色已淡，司祭就应将他隔离七天。

text_en: The priest shall examine him the seventh day; if it is spreading in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him unclean. This is a leprous disease.
text_cn: 到第七天，司祭再查看他，若斑痕在皮肤上蔓延开了，司祭就应声明他是不洁的：这是癞病的症候。

text_en: But if the spot remains in one place and does not spread in the skin but has abated, it is a swelling from the burn, and the priest shall pronounce him clean; for it is the scar of the burn.
text_cn: 但若斑痕留在原处，没有在皮肤上蔓延，颜色已淡，这只是火伤的肿胀，司祭应声明他是洁净的，因为这只是火伤疤痕。

text_en: When a man or woman has a disease on the head or in the beard,
text_cn: 不拘男女，若在头上或嘴上有疮痕，

text_en: the priest shall examine the disease. If it appears deeper than the skin and the hair in it is yellow and thin, the priest shall pronounce him unclean; it is an itch, a leprous disease of the head or the beard.
text_cn: 司祭应查看疮痕，若见患处似乎深过皮肤，而且长了黄色细毛，司祭应声明他是不洁的：这是癣疥，是头上或嘴上的癞病。

text_en: If the priest examines the itching disease, and it appears no deeper than the skin and there is no black hair in it, the priest shall confine the person with the itching disease for seven days.
text_cn: 但若司祭查看癣疥患处不见得深过皮肤，上面也没有黑毛，司祭就应将这患癣疥的人隔离七天。

text_en: On the seventh day the priest shall examine the itch; if the itch has not spread, and there is no yellow hair in it, and the itch appears to be no deeper than the skin,
text_cn: 到第七天，司祭再查看患处，若见癣疥没有蔓延，上面也没有黑毛，而且不见得深过皮肤，

text_en: he shall shave, but the itch he shall not shave. The priest shall confine the person with the itch for seven days more.
text_cn: 这人就应剃去须发，只不剃生癣疥处；司祭应将他再隔离七天。

text_en: On the seventh day the priest shall examine the itch; if the itch has not spread in the skin and it appears to be no deeper than the skin, the priest shall pronounce him clean. He shall wash his clothes and be clean.
text_cn: 到第七天，司祭再查看癣(xuǎn)疥(jiè)，如果见癣疥在皮肤上没有蔓延，不见得深过皮肤，司祭就应声明他是洁净的；洗过衣服，就洁净了。

text_en: But if the itch spreads in the skin after he was pronounced clean,
text_cn: 但若在声明他洁净以后，癣疥在皮肤上又蔓延开了，

text_en: the priest shall examine him. If the itch has spread in the skin, the priest need not seek for the yellow hair; he is unclean.
text_cn: 司祭应再查看，若见癣疥在皮肤上蔓延了，司祭不必再检查黄毛，患者已是不洁净的。

text_en: But if in his eyes the itch is checked, and black hair has grown in it, the itch is healed, he is clean; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
text_cn: 但若癣疥的颜色未变，上面又生有黑毛，癣疥已治好，患者已洁净，司祭应声明患者是洁净的。

text_en: When a man or a woman has spots on the skin of the body, white spots,
text_cn: 不拘男女，若肉皮上起了些斑痕，即白色的斑痕，

text_en: the priest shall make an examination, and if the spots on the skin of the body are of a dull white, it is a rash that has broken out on the skin; he is clean.
text_cn: 司祭就应查看；如见肉皮上的斑痕呈灰白色，那是皮肤上起的皮疹，患者是洁净的。

text_en: If anyone loses the hair from his head, he is bald but he is clean.
text_cn: 若人的头发掉了，成了秃头，他是洁净的；

text_en: If he loses the hair from his forehead and temples, he has baldness of the forehead but he is clean.
text_cn: 若人头顶上的头发掉了，成了前脑秃的人，他是洁净的。

text_en: But if there is on the bald head or the bald forehead a reddish-white diseased spot, it is a leprous disease breaking out on his bald head or his bald forehead.
text_cn: 但是，如果在脑后或脑前的秃处，起了白中带红的疮痕，这是他脑后或脑前的秃处起的癞病。

text_en: The priest shall examine him; if the diseased swelling is reddish-white on his bald head or on his bald forehead, which resembles a leprous disease in the skin of the body,
text_cn: 司祭应查看，若见他脑后或脑前秃处肿起的地方白中带红，看来仿佛肉皮上生的癞病，

text_en: he is leprous, he is unclean. The priest shall pronounce him unclean; the disease is on his head.
text_cn: 这人即是癞病人，已是不洁，司祭应声明他是不洁的，因为他头上有了癞病的症象。

text_en: The person who has the leprous disease shall wear torn clothes and let the hair of his head be disheveled; and he shall cover his upper lip and cry out, “Unclean, unclean. ”
text_cn: 凡身患癞病的人，应穿撕裂的衣服，披头散发，将口唇遮住，且喊说：“不洁！不洁！”

text_en: He shall remain unclean as long as he has the disease; he is unclean. He shall live alone; his dwelling shall be outside the camp.
text_cn: 在他患癞病的时日内，常是不洁的。他既是不洁的，就应独居；他的住处应在营外。

text_en: Concerning clothing: when a leprous disease appears in it, in woolen or linen cloth,
text_cn: 若衣服上有了癞病的迹象，不拘是毛衣或麻衣，

text_en: in warp or woof of linen or wool, or in a skin or in anything made of skin,
text_cn: 或用麻及毛纺织或编织的布，或皮革，或任何皮制的物品上，有了癞病的迹象；

text_en: if the disease shows greenish or reddish in the garment, whether in warp or woof or in skin or in anything made of skin, it is a leprous disease and shall be shown to the priest.
text_cn: 若衣服或皮革，或纺织或编织的布，或任何皮制的器具上，有了发绿或发红的斑痕：这就是癞病的迹象，应交由司祭查看。

text_en: The priest shall examine the disease, and put the diseased article aside for seven days.
text_cn: 司祭查看斑痕以后，应将带有斑痕的物品收藏七天。

text_en: He shall examine the disease on the seventh day. If the disease has spread in the cloth, in warp or woof, or in the skin, whatever be the use of the skin, this is a spreading leprous disease; it is unclean.
text_cn: 到第七天，司祭再查看那斑痕，如果斑痕在衣服上，或纺织或编织的布上，或皮革上，或在任何皮制的物品上蔓延开了，这就是恶性癞病的迹象，物品即是不洁的。

text_en: He shall burn the clothing, whether diseased in warp or woof, woolen or linen, or anything of skin, for it is a spreading leprous disease; it shall be burned in fire.
text_cn: 凡带有这斑痕的衣服，用毛或麻纺织或编织的布，或任何皮制的器具，都应焚烧；因为这是恶性的癞病，应用火烧毁。

text_en: If the priest makes an examination, and the disease has not spread in the clothing, in warp or woof or in anything of skin,
text_cn: 但若司祭查看时，见斑痕在衣服上，或纺织或编织的布上，或任何皮制的器具上，没有蔓延，

text_en: the priest shall command them to wash the article in which the disease appears, and he shall put it aside seven days more.
text_cn: 司祭当吩咐人将带有斑痕的物品洗涤，再收藏七天。

text_en: The priest shall examine the diseased article after it has been washed. If the diseased spot has not changed color, though the disease has not spread, it is unclean; you shall burn it in fire, whether the leprous spot is on the inside or on the outside.
text_cn: 司祭查看洗过的物品以后，若见斑痕没有变色，也没有蔓延，物品即是不洁的，应用火烧掉，因为里外都腐蚀了。

text_en: If the priest makes an examination, and the disease has abated after it is washed, he shall tear the spot out of the cloth, in warp or woof, or out of skin.
text_cn: 但若司祭查看时，见斑痕在洗涤后已变暗淡，应从衣服，或皮革，或纺织或编织的布上，将那块撕去；

text_en: If it appears again in the garment, in warp or woof, or in anything of skin, it is spreading; you shall burn with fire that in which the disease appears.
text_cn: 以后，如果在衣服上，或纺织或编织的布上，或任何皮制的器具上，再出现斑痕，即是旧病复发：带有斑痕的物品，就应用火烧了。

text_en: But the cloth, warp or woof, or anything of skin from which the disease disappears when you have washed it, shall then be washed a second time, and it shall be clean.
text_cn: 如果衣服，或纺织或编织的布，或任何皮制的器具，一经洗涤，上面的斑痕就不见了；再洗一次就洁净了。

text_en: This is the ritual for a leprous disease in a cloth of wool or linen, either in warp or woof, or in anything of skin, to decide whether it is clean or unclean.
text_cn: 这是关于毛衣或麻衣，或纺织的布，或编织的布，或任何皮制的器具的癞病迹象，声明洁净与不洁净的法律。”
